news.headline: Hamilton County Deploys Honest Jobs Reentry Navigator to Improve Employment Outcomes & Community Safety
Level: Prison Education Made Simple, Across The Country
New Feature in Reentry Navigator: Employment Tracking is Now Live
Reentry Navigator - What Happens When I Invite My Clients?

paragraphs: Honest Jobs runs a hiring platform for people with criminal records, and states that it helps currently and formerly incarcerated people find employment up to seven times faster. The site describes what it offers as employment for returning citizens.

Job seekers are given written guidance, including a guidebook on how to find a job with a criminal record. A separate workbook is written for incarcerated learners as a step-by-step guide to the same search. The site also publishes a guidebook on fair chance hiring for the employer side of that market.
The section on who the company serves names correctional technology providers. Nonprofits and reentry organizations are named in that same list of groups it works with.
